topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe it's really happening. We promised, didn't we? That no matter what, we'd stay close, that life's storms wouldn't pull us apart. And now this. Moving across the country. How do you even begin to pack up a friendship like ours? It’s not just stuff; it’s memories, late-night calls, inside jokes that nobody else gets. I keep thinking there's a way to make this not real, that maybe I misunderstood or something will change. But it feels like the end of something, or at least the start of something really hard. I hate goodbyes, especially the kind where the distance makes it hurt more.
